paragraphs: Rav Shemen said to Rav Ashi, “But Rami bar Yehezkel taught, and Rav Yosef said …”: Kiddushin 24b. He spoke to Rav Pappa; see above, Rav Shemen bar Abba. [Glosses: Shemen. Sanhedrin 5b: “R' Yohanan said to Rav Shemen.” It appears to be Rav Shemen bar Abba the priest.]
